notes.title: AR-K FINAL EPISODE WILL BE RELEASED THIS SUMMER & SALE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6288271/bbfb475390c22ef4080e2539fb7df392bc0af4d9.png[/img]

Hey folks, how are you doing? 

Summer sale is here, time for big deals... and also huge news for the AR-K community! 

We would like to announce the [b]release of the fourth and final installment[/b] of AR-K. This episode will end the saga, and what's even better, AR-K [b]episodes 1 & 2 are being remastered[/b] to match the quality of "AR-K: The Great Escape"! [b]Both, will be released before the end of this summer.[/b] 

To thank you one more time for your patience. In the next few weeks we'll provide you more details, so stay tuned! 

Best regards & happy summer sales, 
The Gato Salvaje team!

notes.title: GREAT DEAL AND UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hey! We wanna celebrate with the steam community all the fantastic critics AR-K: The Great Escape received in the last months, so we have decided to launch a limited time discount in order to recruit new buddies to try the game.

Thanks a lot to all the AR-K gamers, we'll keep reading your opinions and critics because we wanna keep learning and improving your gameplay experience, it hadn't been possible without you!

Also, new improvements and fixes:
- Complete check on sound EQ and separated volume controls for both voices and music.
- VSync
- Video quality switch option in order to improve the experience for low specs PCs.
- First chapters recap video available from main menu.
- Minor bugs fixed.

Thank you again! Keep adding me @ (steam id: SprietoGato) for any opinions and new ideas to improve the game, as you can see, we love to hear ALL of your critics.

Take care,
Gato Salvaje Studio.

notes.title: Update July 23, 2015
notes.content:
[b]English[/b]

[list]
[*]Some users told us they would like to be able to set different volumes for voices and music and background effects. Now you can configure it in the settings window.
[*]We fixed a bug that occasionally freezed the game when the PDA was used in certain objects.
[*]UI elements improved in some video configurations. Sharpness has been optimized
[/list]

Remember! You can give your feedback in AR-K: The Great Escape official forum. Join our community! :)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/368890/discussions/
---------------------------------------------------- 
[b]Spanish[/b]

[list]
[*]Ahora se puede configurar por separado el volumen de los diálogos y el de la música. 
[*]Se ha solucionado un error que ocasionalmente provocaba que el juego se colgase al usar la PDA en ciertos objetos.
[*]Se ha mejorado la visualización de algunos elementos del interfaz. En algunas configuraciones de pantalla no se veían con suficiente nitidez.
[/list]

Recuerda! Puedes hacer tus comentarios sobre el juego en el foro oficial de AR-K: La Gran Evasión
http://steamcommunity.com/app/368890/discussions/
